summary: Wrote docs/plans/2026-10-25-L3-scratch-and-tmux.md: finish's scratch_done + scratch_rm guard, check.sh newest-only, HARNESS_CACHE, tmpfiles template, the H1a driver-window command, lib/tmux.sh (tmux_name + tmux_reap) for gc and queue.sh, how the suite drives real tmux runs, and the 12 L3 checks by name. Plan only; suite 289/289.
verified_how: check.sh full run: 289/289 green in 505 s; tmux facts probed on a throwaway private server (tmux 3.4); each plan reference checked against bin/harness, lib/driver.sh, lib/check.sh, lib/prompt.sh, lib/queue.sh, tests/run.sh

discoveries.text:
26 tests/run.sh lines read $T/scratch/

// after a run ends (3 on demo); the stub's count-* files span continuations. Plan §2: KEEP_SCRATCH=1 in base-config.sh and every line that rewrites user-config.sh from scratch; the scratch checks use their own HARNESS_CONFIG on a new run `scrub`.

The private tmux server's windows get the suite's env from when the server started, not the caller's: PATH (the $T/bin/claude wrapper, not a symlink: the stub finds fixtures by dirname $0) and XDG_CACHE_HOME=$T/cache must be exported at the top of tests/run.sh. Per-command STUB_* flags never reach a tmux window; tmux runs end through --until-epoch in the past (initializer, then deadline).

tmux display-message -p -t =<s>: '#{session_created}' needs the trailing colon (without it, nothing is printed). The reaper skips a session created after its run's ended (a resume's session before its driver writes driver.pid), so checks create decoy sessions first and write ended after.
bin/harness runs under set -e: the reaper wraps kill-session in if/else and goes before cmd_gc's git fetch.

questions: Defaults taken (plan §8): KEEP_SCRATCH=0 and teardown.out kept beside init.out/check-last.out; the tmpfiles template also excludes /tmp/harness/*/live.lock; TMUX_KEEP_HOURS whole hours (else 24); `queue` becomes a refused run id. Keep these?
proposed_changes: L3-02 step 1: run the scratch check on a new run `scrub` with KEEP_SCRATCH=0, not `demo` (demo's checks read its scratch after the run); demo shows KEEP_SCRATCH=1 instead
L3-04 step 1: gc's reap lines come from the helper (`+ reaped tmux session …`, `would: tmux kill-session -t =<s> (<run> ended)`), the unit step's shape, not through act
L3-04 step 2: add a paused decoy with PAUSE and ended (pausx) and a resume decoy (fresh), so the PAUSE and session-created guards are exercised
